title: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Amendment Act 2014

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 2014
ACT X OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN COASTAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Coastal
Development Authority Act, 1998 (1 of 1998)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 11th
February, 2014]
No.PAB/Legis: V (11)/2014, dated 17-2-2014.---The Balochistan Coastal Development Authority (Amendment) Bill
2014, (Bill No.1 of 2014), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 1st February, 2014 and assented to by the
Governor, Balochistan on 11th February, 2014 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan
Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority Act, 1998 in the
manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Balochistan Coastal Development Authority
(Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.
